newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 6.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Friday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 35.63 points to close at 7305.29.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index lost 10.44 points to 1,108.84.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5154/64 a dollar at around 0055 GMT, steady from its Kuala Lumpur ending on Thursday at 2.5160/70.
* Engineering firm Kai Peng reported to be buying the remaining 40.59 percent in Maju Steel Sdn Bhd for 64.3 million ringgit.
* Property developer and publisher Malaysian Resources Corp said it holds a 27.1 percent equity interest in financial services firm Rashid Hussain Bhd as at June 5.
